decisions.title: Alameda Drain Trail Master Plan and Design Notice
decisions.description: Announces the Alameda Drain Trail master-planning and design effort from I-40 to Sandia Pueblo, outlining intended trail, landscaping, water-harvesting, rest-area, maintenance, public-input, design, and construction work.
decisions.provenance_status: official City metadata page and byte-identical City-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative two-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; both duplicate-format notice pages, scope, planning limits, schedule, and stakeholder process were reviewed.
The 2015 project contact is not republished because it is historical and may no longer be current.

decisions.title: City of Albuquerque MS4 Monitoring Data for Water Year 2015
decisions.description: Explains Albuquerque's 2015 stormwater monitoring submission, permit transition, reporting cycles, bacterial and chemical loading, wet-weather sampling, dry-weather screening, discharge reports, and related AMAFCA water-quality attachments.
decisions.provenance_status: official City metadata page and byte-identical City-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative four-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; the complete reporting-cycle explanation, attachment index, permit chronology, and partner submissions were reviewed.
Retained as the overview connecting the separately archived 2015 bacterial-loading and monitoring-status records.

decisions.title: New Mexico 2040 Statewide Long-Range Multimodal Transportation Plan Briefing
decisions.description: Documents NMDOT's 2014 briefing to Albuquerque's bicycle advisory committee on the developing 2040 statewide plan, including federal requirements, performance goals, project phases, stakeholder structure, surveys, and public priorities.
decisions.provenance_status: official City metadata page and byte-identical City-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 20-page NMDOT presentation preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; all slides, planning requirements, performance goals, stakeholder structure, survey results, and public priorities were reviewed.
Retained as Albuquerque-specific public-engagement history supporting the final statewide 2040 plan.
